answer: Propose a sensor network at a jetty, mesa and knoll. Each voting ID binds one certified chip with a nonexportable key for an epoch and submits signed nonce-bound readings. Validators check manufacturer certificates, signatures and one ID per chip serial per epoch. Failed checks or missing readings mean no vote that epoch. Exclusive hardware is the cost: n IDs require n chips. This assumes unclonable keys and honest issuers. Renting chips still enables Sybils; attestation proves device access, not truthful readings or unique humans.
